title: Figures 24-25: pumping fiber lasers and large vs small diameter fiber lasers
description: Figure 24, "Pumping Fiber Lasers," depicts pump fibers (yellow) bundled into a blue fiber with a highly reflective grating, low index polymer and output coupler grating, plus inset cross-sections of fiber bundles. Figure 25, "Large and Small Diameter Fiber Lasers," shows laser pump diodes feeding an active fiber (side view) with ray paths, an end view of seven pump fibers around an active fiber, and a note on total internal reflection angle setting divergence and beam quality. Both are credited to the Directed Energy Professional Society.
